description: Hue arithmetic of the component modes (compositor-blend-gaps.md section 3.3, decision 067): per texture set a lower and an upper fill, the upper in the set's mode: s0 Tint and s1 Color of the authored hue-grid over a uniform (0.5, 0, 0), s2 Saturation of a uniform (0.5, 0, 0) over the hue-grid, s3 Value of a uniform grey 0.25 over the hue-grid, s4 Tint of the transposed hue-grid over the hue-grid; s5-s7 the empty stack. Upper opacities per channel: RGB32F 1, RGB16F 1, RGB16 1, sRGB8 1, RGB32F 0.5, RGB16 0.5, L16 1, RGB32F 0.25. The L16 channel takes the hue-grid's red component and uniform greys of the colours' largest component.
